title: A config error hierarchy
hints: A custom exception is `class MissingKeyError(ConfigError):` with an __init__ that calls super().__init__(message) and then sets self.key.
Use `if key not in config: raise MissingKeyError(key)`; `config.get(key)` cannot tell None from absent.
In get_int: `try: return int(value) except (ValueError, TypeError) as e: raise InvalidValueError(key, value) from e`.
